name: Birth Certificate
issuing_office: Registrar of Births and Deaths for the MCD zone where the event occurred
department: Municipal Corporation of Delhi, Public Health Department
fee: Within 21 days ₹0; day 22 to 30 ₹2; after 30 days and within one year ₹5; after one year ₹10. Addition of a child's name after one year carries ₹10.
processing_time: Institutional registration can be immediate after an accepted report; the MCD citizen charter gives up to one week for a general certificate request.
online_process: Use the MCD Registration of Births and Deaths service for the event location; hospitals submit institutional events and citizens submit home-birth, delayed, correction or certificate requests. https://mcdonline.nic.in/rbd/web/citizen/info
offline_process: Zonal Birth and Death Registration Centre, MCD zone in which the birth occurred
required_documents: For registration within one year: identity proof of the mother, identity proof of the father where available, and vaccination card where available. Registration after one year also requires an SDM order and field verification. Delayed and correction cases require the evidence prompted for that case.
eligibility: For an institutional birth, the hospital or institution reports the event. For a home birth, a parent or eligible informant applies in the MCD zone where the birth occurred.
verification_notes: The row is limited to MCD jurisdiction. The applicant should use NDMC or Delhi Cantonment when the event occurred there. Late-registration conditions follow the MCD manual and citizen charter.

name: Death Certificate
issuing_office: Registrar of Births and Deaths for the MCD zone where the event occurred
department: Municipal Corporation of Delhi, Public Health Department
fee: Within 21 days ₹0; day 22 to 30 ₹2; after 30 days and within one year ₹5; after one year ₹10.
processing_time: Institutional registration can be immediate after an accepted report; the MCD citizen charter gives up to one week for a general certificate request.
online_process: Use the MCD Registration of Births and Deaths service for the event location; institutions report deaths and citizens submit non-institutional, delayed, correction or certificate requests. https://mcdonline.nic.in/rbd/web/citizen/info
offline_process: Zonal Birth and Death Registration Centre, MCD zone in which the death occurred
required_documents: Identity proof of the deceased and informant; cremation or burial receipt for a non-institutional death; or FIR, MLC, daily-diary entry or hospital death summary as applicable. Registration after one year also requires an SDM order and field verification.
eligibility: For an institutional death, the hospital or institution reports the event. For a non-institutional death, the eligible informant or family representative applies in the MCD zone where the death occurred.
verification_notes: The row is limited to MCD jurisdiction. The applicant should use NDMC or Delhi Cantonment when the event occurred there.

name: Marriage Certificate
issuing_office: Marriage Officer / Sub-Divisional Magistrate or authorised Deputy Commissioner office
department: Revenue Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
online_process: Apply through Delhi e-District or the jurisdictional Marriage Officer and attend with both spouses and the required witnesses. https://edistrict.delhi.gov.in/Public/Services
offline_process: Jurisdictional SDM / ADM / Deputy Commissioner office, Revenue district serving the applicable Delhi residence or place of marriage
required_documents: Joint signed application; identity and age proof of both spouses; Delhi residence or place-of-marriage proof; marriage photographs and invitation or priest certificate where applicable; separate affidavits; witness identity and address proof; divorce decree or former spouse's death certificate where applicable; embassy or conversion evidence for cases that require it.
eligibility: Spouses whose marriage was solemnised and is registrable under the Hindu Marriage Act, Special Marriage Act, Delhi Compulsory Registration of Marriage Order or another applicable route. Residence, citizenship, age, religion and witness conditions depend on that route.
verification_notes: Current official Revenue pages conflict. One page gives 15 days for Hindu Marriage Act registration and 60 days for Special Marriage Act work, another gives 14 days, and e-District has displayed 21 days. Live pages also show older ₹15/₹100/₹150 figures while current Revenue notifications publish ₹500 revisions. Government Fee and Expected Processing Time are deliberately blank until the department reconciles the applicable route and current schedule.

name: Legal Heir / Succession Certificate
issuing_office: District Magistrate / Sub-Divisional Magistrate / Tehsildar
department: Revenue Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
processing_time: 14 days under the current Revenue service page.
online_process: Apply through Delhi e-District, a CSC or the jurisdictional SDM or Tehsildar office. https://edistrict.delhi.gov.in/Public/Services
offline_process: Jurisdictional SDM / Tehsildar office, Revenue sub-division serving the applicant's Delhi residence
required_documents: Application; identity proof of the applicant and surviving members; present and permanent address proof; death certificate; self-declarations; photographs; and an additional list when more surviving members exist than the form accommodates.
eligibility: An Indian citizen residing in Delhi who needs a Surviving Member Certificate for a deceased family member.
verification_notes: Delhi's administrative service is titled Surviving Member Certificate. It is not a court-issued succession certificate for debts or securities.

name: Aadhaar Card
issuing_office: UIDAI through Aadhaar Seva Kendra or authorised enrolment centre
department: Unique Identification Authority of India
fee: Enrolment ₹0; biometric update ₹125; separate demographic update ₹75; document update at a centre ₹75; colour Aadhaar print ₹40. Online document update on myAadhaar is free until 14 June 2027.
online_process: Visit an Aadhaar centre; selected updates and document update are available through myAadhaar. https://appointments.uidai.gov.in/bookappointment.aspx
offline_process: Aadhaar Seva Kendra / authorised enrolment centre, Use the UIDAI centre locator for Delhi
required_documents: Original Proof of Identity, Proof of Address, Proof of Relationship and Date of Birth documents applicable to the request; Aadhaar number for updates.
eligibility: A resident of India for enrolment; an Aadhaar holder for demographic, biometric or document update.
verification_notes: UIDAI's current service page publishes the national fee schedule and the online document-update waiver date.

name: PAN Card
issuing_office: Income Tax Department
department: Income Tax Department
processing_time: Generally instant after successful Aadhaar verification
online_process: Submit an Instant e-PAN request on the Income Tax e-Filing portal. https://www.incometax.gov.in/iec/foportal/help/all-topics/e-filing-services/instant-e-pan/instant-UM?mobile-app=1
required_documents: Aadhaar number and access to the Aadhaar-linked mobile number for OTP and e-KYC.
eligibility: An individual with no existing PAN, a valid Aadhaar and Aadhaar-linked mobile, who is an adult and is not a representative assessee, can use Instant e-PAN.
verification_notes: This row documents the free Instant e-PAN route. Physical PAN application channels have separate charges.

name: Voter ID / EPIC
issuing_office: Electoral Registration Officer
department: Election Commission of India / Chief Electoral Officer, Delhi
online_process: Submit Form 6 online or through the Electoral Registration Officer or Booth Level Officer. https://voters.eci.gov.in/home/forms
offline_process: Electoral Registration Officer / Booth Level Officer, Jurisdictional Delhi assembly constituency
required_documents: Recent photograph; proof of date of birth; proof of ordinary residence; Aadhaar if voluntarily provided or the prescribed declaration.
eligibility: An Indian citizen aged 18 years or more on a qualifying date and ordinarily resident in the constituency.
verification_notes: Current ECI Form 6 supports the eligibility and proof categories. The Government Fee cell is blank under the brief's restriction on nationally reusable fees.

name: Passport
issuing_office: Regional Passport Office, Delhi / Passport Seva Kendras
department: Ministry of External Affairs
fee: From 1 July 2026: adult 36-page passport ₹2,500; adult 60-page passport ₹3,500; minor 36-page passport ₹1,750; Tatkaal additional fee ₹2,500.
processing_time: Pre-police-verification cases: 3 working days after a clear police report. Post-police-verification or no-police-verification cases: dispatch by the third working day. Tatkaal: generally 1 or 3 working days, subject to the case.
online_process: Apply and pay online, then attend the scheduled PSK or POPSK appointment. https://www.passportindia.gov.in/AppOnlineProject/user/RegistrationBaseAction?request_locale=en
offline_process: Regional Passport Office, Delhi / PSK / POPSK, RPO: Trikoot-3, HUDCO Building, Bhikaji Cama Place, New Delhi 110066; attend the appointment centre selected online
required_documents: Application receipt or ARN; proof of present address; proof of date of birth; identity and citizenship evidence; old passport for reissue; category-specific annexures. Originals are shown at the appointment centre.
eligibility: Indian citizens applying for a fresh passport, reissue or eligible related service.
verification_notes: The fee schedule effective 1 July 2026 is used. The RPO page records Delhi service locations, including the current Jhandewalan PSK location. Processing depends on police-verification mode and completeness.

name: Caste Certificate
issuing_office: District Magistrate / Sub-Divisional Magistrate / Tehsildar
department: Revenue Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
processing_time: 14 days under the current Revenue service pages.
online_process: Apply through Delhi e-District, a CSC or the jurisdictional SDM or Tehsildar office, selecting the SC/ST or OBC service. https://edistrict.delhi.gov.in/Public/Services
offline_process: Jurisdictional SDM / Tehsildar office, Revenue sub-division serving the applicant's Delhi residence
required_documents: Application; identity, date-of-birth and present-address proof; affidavit or self-declaration; Delhi caste certificate of father, brother or sister where available; supporting parental residence or origin records; pre-marriage address evidence for a married woman where relevant; and income or non-creamy-layer evidence for OBC cases.
eligibility: A person claiming a caste notified for Delhi under the applicable SC, ST or OBC list. Delhi residence, parental lineage, migration and OBC non-creamy-layer rules vary by certificate type.
verification_notes: SC/ST and OBC are combined only at PaperTrail's prescribed row level. Applicants must use the category-specific Delhi criteria and evidence route.

name: Income Certificate
issuing_office: District Magistrate / Sub-Divisional Magistrate / Tehsildar
department: Revenue Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
online_process: Apply through Delhi e-District, a CSC or the jurisdictional SDM or Tehsildar office. https://edistrict.delhi.gov.in/Public/Services?q=SuMh8vfILoVPdWI4eUnEyw%3D%3D
offline_process: Jurisdictional SDM / Tehsildar office, Revenue sub-division serving the applicant's Delhi residence
required_documents: Application; identity proof; self-declaration; photograph; present-address proof; salary and other family-income evidence; monthly-expenditure details; and gazetted-officer attestation or other verification details required by the current form.
eligibility: A Delhi resident who needs a family or personal income certificate for an eligible public purpose.
verification_notes: The current canonical Revenue page and e-District service list give 14 days, while a second official Revenue page gives 21 days. Expected Processing Time is blank pending removal or reconciliation of the duplicate official instruction.

name: Domicile / Residence Certificate
issuing_office: District Magistrate / Sub-Divisional Magistrate / Tehsildar
department: Revenue Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
online_process: Apply through Delhi e-District, a CSC or the jurisdictional SDM or Tehsildar office. https://edistrict.delhi.gov.in/Public/Services?q=SuMh8vfILoVPdWI4eUnEyw%3D%3D
offline_process: Jurisdictional SDM / Tehsildar office, Revenue sub-division serving the applicant's Delhi residence
required_documents: Application; identity proof; self-declaration; photograph; present-address proof; date-of-birth proof; continuous Delhi residence evidence covering three years; and the details or attestation requested from a Class I gazetted officer.
eligibility: An Indian citizen who has continuously resided in Delhi for the preceding three years and needs a domicile certificate.
verification_notes: The current canonical Revenue page and e-District service list give 14 days, while a second official Revenue page gives 21 days. Expected Processing Time is blank pending removal or reconciliation of the duplicate official instruction.

name: EWS Certificate
issuing_office: District Magistrate / Sub-Divisional Magistrate / Tehsildar
department: Revenue Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
processing_time: 15 days under the current Delhi service guidance.
online_process: Submit the online Income and Asset Certificate application through Delhi e-District and complete revenue verification. https://edistrict.delhi.gov.in/Public/Services?q=SuMh8vfILoVPdWI4eUnEyw%3D%3D
offline_process: Jurisdictional SDM / Tehsildar office, Revenue sub-division serving the applicant's Delhi residence
required_documents: Delhi address proof; identity proof; income-tax returns for the preceding three years where filed; agriculture and immovable-property records from competent authorities; PAN where held; and the prescribed affidavit listing family income and assets.
eligibility: A Delhi applicant who is outside the SC, ST and OBC reservation categories and meets the current EWS family-income and asset conditions for the relevant year.
verification_notes: The Delhi procedure and evidence are current, but the reviewed pages did not expose one consolidated, dated table of the live numerical family-income and asset limits. Those thresholds must be checked against the certificate purpose and current Government of India or Delhi instruction before filing. Government Fee is blank.

name: Ration Card
issuing_office: Assistant Commissioner / Food Supply Officer under Delhi NFSA administration
department: Food, Supplies and Consumer Affairs Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
processing_time: 30 days in the current Delhi e-District service listing, subject to household and field verification.
online_process: Apply through Delhi e-District or the Delhi National Food Security portal and complete circle-level verification. https://edistrict.delhi.gov.in/Public/Services
offline_process: Circle Food and Supplies Office, Food-supply circle serving the household's Delhi address
required_documents: Aadhaar details of all family members; identity of the eldest eligible female head of household; Delhi residence proof where the Aadhaar address differs; family-income certificate; previous ration card where held; and the prescribed undertaking concerning exclusion criteria.
eligibility: A Delhi household meeting the current National Food Security Act inclusion rules for Priority Household or Antyodaya Anna Yojana and not falling under the exclusion criteria.
verification_notes: Delhi's current public distribution route uses NFSA categories. Household eligibility is determined under the current Delhi rules and verification process.

name: Senior Citizen Card
issuing_office: Delhi Police Senior Citizen Cell / jurisdictional police station
department: Delhi Police
online_process: Complete Delhi Police Senior Citizen pre-registration and follow the verification or contact instructions from the jurisdictional unit. https://seniorcitizen.delhipolice.gov.in/User/PreRegistration
offline_process: Jurisdictional police station / Senior Citizen Cell, Police station serving the senior citizen's Delhi residence
required_documents: Mobile number and date of birth are required to begin online pre-registration; identity, address, household and emergency-contact details are completed in the subsequent verified workflow.
eligibility: A person aged 60 years or more who lives alone or with a spouse, or who lives with family but remains alone for long periods during the day.
verification_notes: The official portal verifies the age and living-arrangement scope and the first registration fields. The full post-OTP document checklist, fee treatment and end-to-end response time are not published on the reviewed public pages.

name: Old Age / Widow Pension
issuing_office: District Social Welfare Office or District Women and Child Development Office
department: Social Welfare Department / Women and Child Development Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
processing_time: 45 days in the Delhi e-District service schedule, subject to district verification and sanction.
online_process: Apply through Delhi e-District under the applicable old-age or women-in-distress pension service and complete district verification. https://edistrict.delhi.gov.in/Public/Services
offline_process: District Social Welfare Office / District WCD Office, District office serving the applicant's Delhi residence
required_documents: Age proof; evidence of five-year Delhi residence; Aadhaar; singly operated bank-account details; income declaration and supporting evidence; photograph; and death, divorce, separation, destitution or abandonment evidence for the applicable women's pension category.
eligibility: Old-age assistance: a person aged 60 or more, resident in Delhi for at least five years, with annual family income up to ₹1 lakh, an Aadhaar-mapped singly operated Delhi bank account and no overlapping pension. Women-in-distress pension: an eligible widow, divorcee, separated, destitute or abandoned woman aged 18 or more meeting the same residence, income, bank and non-duplication conditions.
verification_notes: Two distinct Delhi schemes are combined because the prescribed PaperTrail list has one row. Eligibility evidence differs by scheme and case. The reviewed official pages did not publish a separate applicant filing fee, so Government Fee is blank.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship
issuing_office: Delhi welfare department, National Scholarship Portal and the applicant's institution
department: Department for Welfare of SC, ST, OBC and Minorities, Government of NCT of Delhi
online_process: Use the National Scholarship Portal for the centrally sponsored route or Delhi e-District for a notified Delhi scheme, then complete institution and department verification. https://scholarships.gov.in/
offline_process: Applicant's institution / District Welfare Office, Institution and welfare district handling the application
required_documents: Aadhaar and NSP One-Time Registration details where applicable; caste or category certificate; Delhi residence proof; current income certificate; Aadhaar-seeded bank account; prior examination record; current admission, fee and institution verification; attendance evidence; and declaration concerning other scholarships.
eligibility: A Delhi-resident student in an eligible post-matric course who meets the current category, family-income, institution, academic and non-duplication conditions for the selected SC, OBC or other notified scholarship.
verification_notes: Delhi publishes several category- and year-specific scholarship routes. The exact income ceiling, award, filing window and disposal time depend on the selected scheme and academic-year notice. Government Fee and Expected Processing Time are blank.

name: Ayushman Bharat / State Health Scheme Card
issuing_office: State Health Agency, Delhi / National Health Authority
department: National Health Authority / Department of Health and Family Welfare, Government of NCT of Delhi
online_process: Check beneficiary status and complete e-KYC or card generation on the NHA beneficiary portal or through an Ayushman help desk at an empanelled facility. https://beneficiary.nha.gov.in/
offline_process: Ayushman help desk / State Health Agency facilitation point, Selected empanelled facility or Delhi scheme office
required_documents: Aadhaar or accepted identity proof; mobile number; family or ration-card details and beneficiary-family evidence as prompted by the official beneficiary portal; age evidence for the 70-plus route; and e-KYC or family-member confirmation.
eligibility: A person in an eligible PM-JAY beneficiary family, and eligible senior citizens aged 70 or more under the Ayushman Vay Vandana route, subject to the current beneficiary database and scheme rules.
verification_notes: Delhi joined AB PM-JAY on 5 April 2025 with a Delhi top-up announced above the central cover. Live beneficiary eligibility is database-driven. The reviewed pages did not publish one fixed applicant fee or end-to-end card-generation SLA, so those cells are blank.

name: Disability Certificate / UDID
issuing_office: Notified Delhi medical authority through the UDID system
department: Directorate General of Health Services, Delhi / Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
online_process: Register on the UDID portal, upload the application and evidence, select or receive the certifying authority, and attend medical assessment when directed. https://www.swavlambancard.gov.in/
offline_process: Notified Delhi disability-certifying hospital / medical board, Hospital allocated or selected through the UDID process
required_documents: Aadhaar or accepted e-KYC identity; photograph; signature or thumb impression; address proof; disability and medical records; and referral, specialist or diagnostic reports directed by the assigned medical authority.
eligibility: A person with a disability seeking assessment, a disability certificate or a Unique Disability ID through a notified Delhi medical authority.
verification_notes: Delhi routes disability certification and UDID work through the national portal and notified hospitals. Medical evidence and validity are case-specific. The reviewed public pages did not publish one applicant fee or uniform disposal time.

name: Health Insurance Card
issuing_office: Delhi Arogya Kosh through the treating Delhi government hospital
department: Directorate General of Health Services, Government of NCT of Delhi
online_process: Submit the prescribed Delhi Arogya Kosh assistance application through the treating government hospital's Medical Superintendent or Medical Director. https://dgehs.delhi.gov.in/sites/default/files/inline-files/dajsal.pdf
offline_process: Treating Delhi government hospital / Delhi Arogya Kosh, Through the hospital Medical Superintendent; Directorate headquarters, Swasthya Sewa Nideshalaya Bhawan, Karkardooma, Delhi 110032
required_documents: Delhi NFSA ration card or income certificate; evidence of three-year Delhi residence; original treatment estimate certified by the treating doctor and Medical Superintendent or Medical Director; two patient photographs; and the relevant medical records.
eligibility: A patient with annual family income up to ₹3 lakh who has resided in Delhi for at least three years and is receiving eligible treatment in a Delhi government hospital.
verification_notes: This is a treatment-assistance route of up to ₹5 lakh, not a standalone insurance card. The reviewed official materials do not provide one applicant fee or fixed end-to-end sanction time.

name: Land Record of Rights
issuing_office: Tehsildar / Revenue record room
department: Revenue Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
processing_time: 21 days for the e-District Issuance of Record of Rights service; online viewing is immediate after a successful search.
online_process: Search Indraprastha Bhulekh for information; use the e-District or Tehsil route when a certified Record of Rights is required. https://dlrc.delhi.gov.in/
offline_process: Jurisdictional Tehsil / Revenue record room, Revenue sub-division serving the land parcel
required_documents: For online viewing, select district, sub-division, village and the available khata, khatoni or khasra particulars. A certified-copy request requires the property particulars and applicant identity or authority requested by the revenue office.
eligibility: Any user may search the online land-record display; a person requiring an official certified Record of Rights applies through the jurisdictional revenue office or e-District route.
verification_notes: Indraprastha Bhulekh states that its online display is for information. A user needing a legally certified copy should use the Tehsil or e-District issuance route. The current certified-copy fee was not exposed on the reviewed pages.

name: Mutation
issuing_office: Tehsildar through Patwari and Kanungo verification
department: Revenue Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
fee: Up to ₹5 per mutation under section 24 of the Delhi Land Revenue Act, subject to the current prescribed rule.
online_process: Apply through the jurisdictional Tehsil or Delhi e-District; Patwari and Kanungo verification precedes the Tehsildar's order and record entry. https://edistrict.delhi.gov.in/Public/Services?q=2IcJdUtgEJkl57hIr9galg%3D%3D
offline_process: Jurisdictional Tehsil office, Revenue sub-division serving the land parcel
required_documents: Application; registered transfer deed or succession and death evidence; current Record of Rights and khasra or khata particulars; applicant identity and address; and supporting family, court, revenue or authority documents applicable to the claimed change.
eligibility: A transferee, successor or authorised claimant seeking entry of a registered transfer, inheritance or other recognised change in the Delhi land revenue record.
verification_notes: An official Revenue workflow gives 21 days while the current e-District service listing gives 16 days. Expected Processing Time is blank until the department reconciles the SLA. The statutory fee is stated as a ceiling; the office should confirm the amount currently prescribed for the case.

name: Encumbrance Certificate
issuing_office: District Magistrate / Sub-Divisional Magistrate
department: Revenue Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
processing_time: 21 days under the Delhi Revenue service page.
online_process: Apply to the jurisdictional Revenue district through the prescribed service and present original property records for verification. https://edistrict.delhi.gov.in/Public/Services
offline_process: Jurisdictional SDM / District Revenue office, Revenue district serving the property
required_documents: Application; original ownership, sale deed or general power of attorney; Delhi ration card; applicant affidavit; affidavits from two advocates; and a reference letter from the authority that requires the certificate.
eligibility: A property owner or eligible applicant requiring a Delhi Non-Encumbrance Certificate for the stated property and purpose.
verification_notes: This Revenue certificate should not be confused with an online title guarantee. The authority-reference and advocate-affidavit requirements are specific to Delhi's published service.

name: Sale Deed / Property Registration
issuing_office: Sub-Registrar
department: Revenue Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
fee: Stamp duty is 6% for a male buyer and 4% for a female buyer on the higher of consideration and applicable circle-rate value; registration fee is 1% plus ₹100 pasting charge.
processing_time: Normally 15 days under the Delhi Revenue property-registration service, subject to complete documents and any required permission.
online_process: Prepare and e-stamp the instrument, enter the transaction in NGDRS Delhi, book an appointment, and present the parties, witnesses and originals before the jurisdictional Sub-Registrar. https://ngdrs.delhi.gov.in/NGDRS_DL/
offline_process: Jurisdictional Sub-Registrar Office, Sub-Registrar district serving the property
required_documents: Prepared deed; title and previous ownership documents; identity and PAN or Form 60 of parties; two witnesses with identity proof; e-stamp and registration-fee receipt; photographs and biometrics; and authority, conversion, leasehold, permission or NOC documents triggered by the property.
eligibility: Parties executing a registrable conveyance of immovable property in Delhi, appearing personally or through a legally valid authorised representative.
verification_notes: The stated stamp-duty rates are the general Delhi sale-deed rates on the higher valuation base. Property type, ownership pattern and legal exemption can alter the calculation.

name: Property Tax
issuing_office: MCD Property Tax Department
department: Municipal Corporation of Delhi
processing_time: The online return and receipt are generated after successful submission and payment; assessment, UPIC creation or discrepancy scrutiny may require further municipal action.
online_process: Register or log in to MCD Property Tax, confirm the UPIC and property particulars, calculate liability under the Unit Area System, file the return and pay online. https://mcdonline.nic.in/ptrmcd/web/citizen/property/propertyTaxCalculatorSearchByUpic
offline_process: MCD zonal Property Tax office, MCD zone serving the property
required_documents: UPIC; PAN; applicant identity; property address and ownership or occupancy record; and, for creation or correction of a UPIC, the property instrument and government photo identity requested by MCD.
eligibility: The owner, occupier or authorised taxpayer responsible for a property in MCD jurisdiction; a UPIC is required for online filing and payment.
verification_notes: Tax is property-specific and must be calculated on the current MCD portal; a single amount would be misleading. The row does not cover NDMC or Delhi Cantonment rates. Government Fee is blank because the accessible page did not present one consolidated 2026-27 rate table.

name: Rent Agreement Registration
issuing_office: Sub-Registrar
department: Revenue Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
fee: Registration fee ₹1,000 plus ₹100 pasting charge; stamp duty is variable under Article 35 according to rent, premium, term and renewal conditions.
processing_time: Normally 15 days under the Delhi Revenue property-registration service, subject to complete documents and any required permission.
online_process: Prepare and e-stamp the lease, enter it in NGDRS Delhi, book an appointment and present the parties, witnesses and originals before the jurisdictional Sub-Registrar. https://ngdrs.delhi.gov.in/NGDRS_DL/
offline_process: Jurisdictional Sub-Registrar Office, Sub-Registrar district serving the leased property
required_documents: Lease deed in the required copies; identity and PAN or Form 60 of the parties; two witnesses with identity proof; lessor's title or authority; e-stamp and fee receipt; photographs and biometrics; and permission or NOC required by the property's tenure.
eligibility: The lessor and lessee executing a compulsorily or voluntarily registrable lease or rent instrument for Delhi immovable property.
verification_notes: A lease from year to year, for more than one year or reserving yearly rent is compulsorily registrable. The stamp-duty amount must be calculated from Article 35 and the actual instrument.

name: RERA Registration
issuing_office: Delhi RERA
department: Real Estate Regulatory Authority for NCT of Delhi
processing_time: 30 days from receipt of a complete application under the RERA Act, unless the authority rejects the application with reasons.
online_process: Create the promoter and project account on Delhi RERA, submit the project details and evidence, pay the system-calculated fee and respond to authority scrutiny. https://www.rera.delhi.gov.in/
offline_process: Real Estate Regulatory Authority, NCT of Delhi, Vikas Sadan, INA, New Delhi 110023
required_documents: Promoter and enterprise details; PAN and constitutional records; title and encumbrance documents; approvals and commencement certificate; sanctioned, layout and development-work plans; contractor, architect, engineer and agent details; pro forma allotment and sale documents; and statutory declarations including the separate project-account commitment.
eligibility: A promoter of a real-estate project in Delhi that is not exempt from registration under the Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act.
verification_notes: The statutory project-registration route and common evidence are verified. The reviewed Delhi pages did not expose a stable current project-fee table or a single category-complete upload checklist, so Government Fee is blank and the portal result controls exact uploads.

name: Society / Housing NOC
issuing_office: Co-operative housing society under oversight of the Registrar Cooperative Societies
department: Registrar Cooperative Societies, Government of NCT of Delhi
fee: ₹500 transfer fee plus share and admission money according to the registered bye-laws; a separate society entry fee should not be charged for the NOC.
processing_time: 30 days for transfer of membership under the published Registrar Cooperative Societies guidance.
online_process: Submit the prescribed transfer set to the co-operative housing society; escalate a statutory dispute or non-compliance through the Registrar Cooperative Societies route. https://rcs.delhi.gov.in/rcs/transfer-membershipforms-affidavit
offline_process: Registered co-operative housing society / Registrar Cooperative Societies, Society office; RCS, Parliament Street, New Delhi 110001
required_documents: Registered power of attorney, agreement, sale or conveyance record applicable to the transfer; affidavit on ₹10 non-judicial stamp paper concerning society liabilities; original share certificate or prescribed indemnity; transfer receipt; and inheritance, nomination, identity or authority evidence for the case.
eligibility: A member, purchaser, transferee or legal heir seeking transfer of membership or the society record and NOC associated with a Delhi co-operative housing property.
verification_notes: The prescribed PaperTrail label is broader than Delhi's published co-operative housing membership-transfer service. This row documents that specific, verifiable NOC-related route.

name: New Electricity Connection
issuing_office: BSES Yamuna Power Limited for the documented service area
department: Applicable Delhi electricity distribution licensee
fee: Documented BSES schedule: domestic security deposit ₹600 per kW up to 2 kW, ₹900 per kW above 2 and up to 5 kW, and ₹1,200 per kW above 5 kW; normative service-line charge ₹3,000 up to 5 kW, with road-restoration and higher-load charges added as applicable.
processing_time: Where network augmentation is not required: 7 days without road cutting and 15 days where road cutting is required; augmentation cases follow the longer regulatory track.
online_process: Apply to the distribution licensee for the premises, upload or present identity and occupancy proof, complete site feasibility and pay the assessed charges. https://www.bsesdelhi.com/web/bypl/new-connection
offline_process: BYPL customer-care centre for the documented route, Customer-care centre serving the supply address
required_documents: Applicant identity; ownership or occupancy proof such as title, conveyance, allotment, mutation, lease or permitted tenancy evidence; owner undertaking or NOC where triggered; and entity registration plus board or authorised-signatory evidence for an organisation.
eligibility: An owner, occupier, tenant or authorised organisation seeking supply at premises within the applicable distribution licensee's area.
verification_notes: Delhi is divided among distribution licensees. The fee and SLA shown are the official BSES route documented here and must not be applied automatically to TPDDL or NDMC electricity areas.

name: New Water / Sewerage Connection
issuing_office: Delhi Jal Board zonal revenue office
department: Delhi Jal Board
fee: ₹10 application or form-processing fee; connection, development, road-restoration and category charges vary with the assessed service.
processing_time: 15 days under the Delhi Jal Board ease-of-doing-business service schedule, subject to network and site feasibility.
online_process: Submit the new-connection request on the DJB Revenue Management System, upload the evidence, complete site verification and pay the assessed demand. https://www.djb.gov.in/DJBRMSPortal/portal/newConnection.html
offline_process: Delhi Jal Board zonal revenue office, DJB zone serving the property
required_documents: Applicant identity; property ownership or occupancy proof; self-declaration where accepted in place of a registered ownership document; owner, MCD or DPCC NOC where triggered; and approved drawings, demand calculations or technical details for bulk or non-domestic cases.
eligibility: A Delhi property owner or eligible tenant with identity and ownership or occupancy evidence where the DJB water or sewer network is available.
verification_notes: The ₹10 amount is only the published application or processing component; the portal assesses the remaining connection charges. NDMC and Delhi Cantonment properties use their own authorities.

name: Building Plan Approval and Completion Certificate
issuing_office: MCD Building Department through Online Building Plan Approval System
department: Municipal Corporation of Delhi, Town Planning / Building Department
processing_time: The MCD citizen charter provides an overall 60-day service period including sanction through completion, subject to category, complete submissions and external NOCs.
online_process: The owner engages a registered professional, submits the plan through MCD OBPS, obtains external NOCs where triggered, completes construction inspections and applies for completion or occupancy certification. https://mcdonline.nic.in/tpobps-mcd/web/citizen/info
offline_process: MCD zonal Building Department, MCD zone serving the property
required_documents: Architectural drawings in the prescribed digital formats; layout and site plan; ownership deed and owner or lessor NOC; combined e-undertaking; structural-stability certificate; rainwater-harvesting and green-building undertakings; professional engagement documents; and fire, airport, heritage or other NOCs when triggered.
eligibility: A property owner in MCD jurisdiction acting through a registered architect or engineer for sanction, construction-stage approvals and completion or occupancy certification.
verification_notes: MCD building charges vary by plot, use, floor area, sanction type and applicable levy. The reviewed portal did not expose one consolidated current fee table suitable for a single PaperTrail row, so Government Fee is blank. Other Delhi planning jurisdictions require separate confirmation.

name: Driving Licence
issuing_office: Zonal Transport Office / Licensing Authority
department: Transport Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
online_process: Apply on Sarathi through the Delhi Transport service, complete the learner test and appointment, then pass the driving competence test for the requested class. https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/sarathiservice/stateSelection.do
offline_process: Jurisdictional Delhi zonal transport office, Zonal office selected for the Delhi application
required_documents: Application in the prescribed form; proof of age and Delhi residence; photograph and signature; Form 1 self-declaration; Form 1A medical certificate for transport applicants and applicants aged 40 or more; guardian consent for the under-18 category; and existing LMV licence, education or training evidence where the transport category requires it.
eligibility: A person aged 16 or more for a gearless motorcycle up to 50 cc with guardian consent, 18 or more for a non-transport vehicle, or 20 or more for a transport vehicle subject to the additional experience and qualification conditions.
verification_notes: The prescribed row combines learner, permanent, renewal and transport classes. Documents and tests vary by class. Government Fee is blank under the brief's restriction on nationally reusable transport fees, and no single end-to-end SLA applies across all classes.

name: Vehicle Registration Certificate
issuing_office: Registering Authority / Zonal Transport Office
department: Transport Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
online_process: The dealer or owner files through Vahan and the Delhi Transport route, pays assessed tax and charges, submits the documents and presents the vehicle for inspection where directed. https://vahan.parivahan.gov.in/vahanservice/vahan/ui/statevalidation/homepage.xhtml
offline_process: Jurisdictional Delhi registering authority, Zonal transport office serving the owner's Delhi address
required_documents: Form 20; sale certificate Form 21; road-worthiness certificate Form 22; valid insurance; owner address and identity proof; Form 34 where financed; tax and parking-fee evidence; PAN or Form 60 or 61; invoice documents; and the vehicle for physical inspection where required.
eligibility: The owner of a new or otherwise registrable motor vehicle whose Delhi address or vehicle use places the application under a Delhi registering authority.
verification_notes: The official Delhi page verifies the new-vehicle document set and same-day fee receipt, but smart-card preparation and other RC services follow separate timelines. Government Fee and a single end-to-end Expected Processing Time are blank under the research constraints.

name: GST Registration
issuing_office: Jurisdictional Central or Delhi State GST officer
department: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs / Department of Trade and Taxes, Delhi
processing_time: Normally 7 working days where Aadhaar authentication succeeds and no action is required; up to 30 calendar days where Aadhaar authentication is not completed or fails and no earlier action is taken.
online_process: Submit Form GST REG-01 on the GST portal, complete Aadhaar authentication or physical verification and respond to any clarification notice. https://www.gst.gov.in/
offline_process: Jurisdictional GST office / GST Suvidha Kendra when directed, Determined by the principal place of business in Delhi
required_documents: PAN; proof of constitution; photographs of proprietor, partners, directors or authorised persons; authorised-signatory proof; principal and additional place-of-business proof; bank details; Aadhaar authentication or GST Suvidha Kendra verification as applicable.
eligibility: A person liable or eligible to register under GST based on turnover, interstate or specified supplies, business form or voluntary-registration rules.
verification_notes: The current GST checklist and Aadhaar-authentication FAQ support the document categories and the two processing tracks. Government Fee is blank because the official material used here does not publish an applicant registration fee.

name: Shops and Establishment Registration
issuing_office: Chief Inspector of Shops and Establishments
department: Labour Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
online_process: Confirm the current position with the Delhi Labour Department before attempting the CIS registration route. https://labourcis.nic.in/
offline_process: Office of the Labour Commissioner, 5, Sham Nath Marg, Delhi 110054
required_documents: The statutory registration statement is Form A and records the employer or manager, establishment address and name, category, employee count and prescribed particulars; the live online checklist depends on whether the registration route is currently operative.
eligibility: The occupier of a shop or commercial establishment covered by the Delhi Shops and Establishments Act, subject to the current legal position on registration.
verification_notes: Current official Labour pages directly conflict. The Inspectorate and Act pages say registration has been kept in abeyance since 23 November 1989, while the Time Frame and Online Services pages advertise free real-time online registration. Government Fee and Expected Processing Time are blank because publishing either position as settled would be unsafe.

name: Trade Licence
issuing_office: MCD General Trade / Storage Licence authority
department: Municipal Corporation of Delhi
fee: Current MCD GTL charge is 15% of the total property tax for the premises and is collected with property tax; the paid property-tax receipt serves as the licence evidence under the current order.
processing_time: Instant after successful online declaration and payment under the current MCD citizen-service model.
online_process: Create or use the MCD property and taxpayer account, submit the GTL self-declaration and premises evidence, and pay the system-calculated amount with property tax. https://mcdonline.nic.in/gtlmcd/web/citizen/gtl/applynew
offline_process: MCD zonal licensing office, MCD zone serving the business premises
required_documents: Applicant government photo identity; legal ownership, lease or occupancy proof for the premises; clear photograph of the establishment frontage and activity; and entity or authorised-signatory evidence where the applicant is an organisation.
eligibility: A trader or occupier carrying on a trade or storage activity covered by the MCD General Trade / Storage Licence system in MCD jurisdiction.
verification_notes: This is MCD's current General Trade / Storage Licence route and not a universal Delhi licence. NDMC and Delhi Cantonment premises require their own authority.

name: Udyam / MSME Registration
issuing_office: Ministry of MSME
department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
processing_time: Certificate is generated online after successful submission and validation.
online_process: Register only on the official Udyam portal using Aadhaar authentication and applicable PAN or GST data. https://udyamregistration.gov.in/UdyamRegistration.aspx
offline_process: District Industries Centre for facilitation, Jurisdictional Delhi District Industries Centre
required_documents: Aadhaar of proprietor, managing partner or authorised person; PAN and GSTIN as applicable. The portal retrieves linked tax data and does not require document uploads for normal registration.
eligibility: A proprietorship, partnership, company, LLP, co-operative, trust or other eligible enterprise meeting the current MSME investment and turnover criteria.
verification_notes: The national official portal states zero cost and warns against unauthorised private sites. Government Fee remains blank because the brief permits nationally reusable fees only for its specified services, which do not include Udyam.

name: FSSAI Registration / Licence
issuing_office: Designated Officer / Central Licensing Authority
department: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India / Department of Food Safety, Delhi
processing_time: Registration follows the statutory 7-day and 30-day steps; licence timelines can extend to 60 days depending on type and inspection.
online_process: Use the FoSCoS eligibility tool, submit the appropriate registration or licence application, upload documents, pay and complete inspection where required. https://foscos.fssai.gov.in/search-eligibility/CL
offline_process: Designated Food Safety Officer / licensing authority, Authority allocated by FoSCoS for the Delhi premises
required_documents: Form B where licensing applies; proprietor, partner or director identity and list; premises possession proof; layout and machinery details for manufacturing; food categories; water analysis, NOCs and activity-specific documents where triggered.
eligibility: Every food business operator; registration or licence type depends on the current nature, scale, capacity and turnover criteria in FoSCoS.
verification_notes: The combined row covers registration, State licence and Central licence. Exact documents, fee and time are generated by the current eligibility result. Government Fee is blank because the brief does not permit reuse of the national FSSAI fee schedule.

name: Professional Tax PTRC/PTEC
issuing_office: Delhi Cantonment Board for the only officially documented local exception
department: Municipal finance authorities in Delhi
online_process: There is no GNCTD, MCD or NDMC PTRC/PTEC registration route. An establishment in Delhi Cantonment should obtain current written confirmation from the Board before assuming liability or exemption. https://echhawani.gov.in/
offline_process: Delhi Cantonment Board, Sadar Bazar, Delhi Cantonment, New Delhi 110010
verification_notes: The Fifth Delhi Finance Commission records that proposed MCD and NDMC profession-tax measures were not implemented and identifies Delhi Cantonment Board as a historic exception. A current Delhi Cantonment rate, registration form, document list and SLA were not published in the reviewed sources, so those fields remain blank.

name: Fire NOC
issuing_office: Director, Delhi Fire Service / authorised fire-safety officer
department: Delhi Fire Service
fee: ₹0 for Delhi Fire Service fire-safety guidelines and Fire Safety Certificate processing.
processing_time: Three weeks for construction-stage fire-safety guidelines; the Fire Safety Certificate follows inspection and recommendation after a complete application.
online_process: Submit the applicable online fire-safety application and plans, respond to scrutiny, complete the site inspection and cure any deficiencies before certificate issue. https://dfs.delhi.gov.in/dfs/online-services
offline_process: Delhi Fire Service headquarters / assigned fire station, Connaught Place Fire Station Building, New Delhi 110001; inspection at the subject premises
required_documents: Form I for fire-safety recommendations; architect and owner compliance certificate; architectural and fire-control plans; pump, tank, hydrant and sprinkler details; hydraulic, smoke-control and other engineering calculations where triggered; common application form; and, for renewal, Forms J and K with the prior certificate and compliance evidence.
eligibility: The owner or occupier of a building or occupancy that requires fire-safety recommendations, inspection and a Fire Safety Certificate under the Delhi Fire Service rules.
verification_notes: The ₹0 fee is explicitly published by Delhi Fire Service. The three-week period applies to fire-safety guidelines; certificate issue still depends on plans, inspection and compliance.

name: Liquor Licence
issuing_office: Excise Department, Delhi
department: Excise Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
fee: ₹5,000 for the documented P-10 temporary permit.
processing_time: Four days under the Delhi Excise citizen charter for the documented P-10 route.
online_process: Apply for the P-10 event permit through the Delhi Excise service, submit event and applicant details, pay the fee and retain the permit at the venue. https://excise.delhi.gov.in/excise/licences
offline_process: Delhi Excise Department, L-Block, Vikas Bhawan, I.P. Estate, New Delhi 110002
required_documents: Application and applicant identity or age proof; event date, venue and function details; invitation or event evidence where applicable; and venue, police, local-body or premises permission when the case triggers it. Liquor must be sourced through an authorised Delhi channel.
eligibility: An individual or organisation seeking a P-10 permit to serve liquor at a specified private function in Delhi; the responsible applicant and consumers must meet the applicable minimum-age and lawful-source conditions.
verification_notes: The prescribed PaperTrail row is broad. This row documents the public-facing P-10 temporary event permit only; commercial retail, hotel, restaurant and wholesale L-series licences have different criteria and fees.

name: EPFO / UAN
issuing_office: EPFO
department: Employees' Provident Fund Organisation
processing_time: UAN is generated or activated after successful Aadhaar face authentication and validation.
online_process: Use UMANG with Aadhaar Face Authentication for allotment and activation; use the EPFO member portal for linked services. https://unifiedportal-mem.epfindia.gov.in/memberinterface/
offline_process: EPFO regional or district office, EPFO office serving the Delhi establishment
required_documents: Aadhaar; Aadhaar-linked mobile; smartphone with UMANG and Aadhaar Face RD applications; facial authentication. Employment and KYC details are linked for member services.
eligibility: An employee who is or becomes an EPF member; the employer links employment, while eligible members can allot and activate UAN through the current UMANG route.
verification_notes: The current circular discontinued direct portal allotment and activation in favour of UMANG Aadhaar Face Authentication.

name: ESI Card
issuing_office: ESIC through the covered employer
department: Employees' State Insurance Corporation
processing_time: Insurance number and e-Pehchan are generated after the employer completes employee registration.
online_process: The employer registers the employee in the ESIC portal; the insured person downloads or receives e-Pehchan and completes identity updates as needed. https://www.esic.gov.in/insured-person-employer-login
offline_process: ESIC branch office / dispensary, Branch office or dispensary allocated to the insured person's area in Delhi
required_documents: Employee and family identity particulars; residential address; dispensary choice; family photograph; nominee and relationship details; employer registration and insurance-number data; and Aadhaar seeding where voluntarily completed.
eligibility: An employee in insurable employment at a covered establishment, together with eligible family members.
verification_notes: The e-Pehchan card is generated through employer registration. Employee and employer contributions are insurance contributions, not a card-issuance fee.

name: Labour Card (BOCW)
issuing_office: Delhi BOCW Welfare Board / District Registering Officer
department: Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
fee: ₹25 at registration: ₹5 one-time registration fee plus ₹20 annual contribution under the current Delhi Board page.
processing_time: 30 days under the Delhi Labour Department service schedule.
online_process: Apply to the Delhi BOCW Welfare Board online or through the district labour route, submit the 90-day work proof and complete verification. https://edistrict.delhi.gov.in/Public/Services
offline_process: District Labour Office / BOCW Welfare Board, District labour office serving the worker's Delhi residence
required_documents: Form XXVII; age proof through school, birth or competent medical record; employer or contractor certificate showing at least 90 days of construction work, or the permitted registered-union or Assistant Labour Commissioner alternative; photograph, address, Aadhaar, bank and nomination details as prompted by the Board.
eligibility: A building or construction worker aged 18 or more and below 60 who worked at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months and is not a member of another statutory welfare fund that disqualifies registration.
verification_notes: The current Board page describes the ₹20 contribution as annual. Older rule reproductions should not be used to convert it into a monthly amount without a current amendment check.

name: Bank Account KYC
issuing_office: Regulated bank or financial institution
department: Reserve Bank of India / regulated bank
online_process: Complete KYC at a branch, through permitted digital KYC or video customer identification, or through an authorised business correspondent for eligible updates.
offline_process: Customer's bank branch / authorised business correspondent, Selected bank branch in Delhi
required_documents: PAN or Form 60; one officially valid document such as passport, driving licence, Aadhaar possession proof, EPIC, NREGA job card or NPR letter; photograph; and additional financial or business information required by the bank's risk policy.
eligibility: An individual opening, operating or periodically updating an account with a regulated bank.
verification_notes: The RBI Master Direction and current amendment support the officially valid document categories and permitted KYC channels. Bank-specific onboarding controls can add requirements.

name: Income Tax Return
issuing_office: Central Board of Direct Taxes / Income Tax Department
department: Income Tax Department
processing_time: The return due date varies by assessment year and taxpayer category; e-verification is generally required within 30 days of filing.
online_process: Select the correct ITR form, prepare and submit through the e-Filing portal, then e-verify within the allowed period. https://www.incometax.gov.in/iec/foportal/help/all-topics/e-filing-services/file-income-tax-return
offline_process: Jurisdictional Income Tax office for assisted or notice proceedings, Jurisdiction determined by PAN and taxpayer profile
required_documents: PAN and Aadhaar-linked access; Form 16 or 16A; AIS and TIS; bank and interest information; business, capital-gain, house-property and deduction records applicable to the chosen ITR form. Returns are annexure-less, but evidence should be retained.
eligibility: A person required or eligible to file an income-tax return for the relevant assessment year under the applicable income, entity and filing rules.
verification_notes: A single row cannot represent every ITR form and assessment-year due date. The common filing and verification process is documented, while form-specific schedules remain taxpayer-dependent. Government Fee is blank.

name: GST Returns (GSTR-1 / GSTR-3B)
issuing_office: Jurisdictional Central or Delhi State GST officer
department: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs / Department of Trade and Taxes, Delhi
processing_time: Standard GSTR-1 due dates are the 11th of the following month for monthly filers and the 13th after the quarter for quarterly filers. GSTR-3B is generally due on the 20th monthly; Delhi QRMP filers generally use the 24th after the quarter, subject to notification extensions.
online_process: Prepare, validate and file GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B through the GST portal, then discharge the net liability through the electronic ledgers. https://www.gst.gov.in/
offline_process: Jurisdictional GST office, Determined by GST registration jurisdiction in Delhi
required_documents: Outward invoices and credit or debit notes; inward-supply and ITC data from GSTR-2B or IMS; tax-liability, electronic-credit and cash-ledger information; amendments and reverse-charge records.
eligibility: A regular GST-registered taxpayer required to furnish outward-supply details in GSTR-1 and liability and input-tax-credit summary in GSTR-3B; special taxpayer categories use different returns.
verification_notes: The standard calendar is stated with an explicit notification-extension caveat. Composition and special-category taxpayers do not use this exact pair in the same way. Government Fee is blank.

name: Eating House Licence
issuing_office: MCD Health Trade Licensing authority for the documented route
department: Municipal Corporation of Delhi, Public Health Department
processing_time: The MCD Health Trade Licensing portal publishes an average application-processing time of one day, subject to category and complete documents.
online_process: Use the MCD Health Trade Licensing portal, select the correct eating-house category, submit declarations and evidence, pay the system-calculated charges and complete any triggered inspection or NOC. https://mcdonline.nic.in/htlmcd/web/citizen/info
offline_process: MCD zonal Public Health / Health Trade Licensing office, MCD zone serving the premises; headquarters at Dr. S.P.M. Civic Centre, Minto Road, New Delhi 110002
required_documents: Ownership, lease or legal occupancy proof; sanctioned building plan, completion certificate or accepted regularisation plan as applicable; applicant and entity constitution evidence; site and activity details; FSSAI record; and Delhi Fire Service, DPCC or other NOCs when the category triggers them.
eligibility: The proprietor, occupier or authorised entity operating an eating house or food-service establishment that falls within the MCD Health Trade Licence categories.
verification_notes: Effective 4 June 2026, the former MHA Unified Portal route was discontinued and applicants were directed to MCD Health Trade Licensing. Exact current fee and uploads vary by trade category, floor area and jurisdiction, so Government Fee is blank.

name: Police Verification for Hotel Guests
issuing_office: Bureau of Immigration / Foreigners Regional Registration Office
department: Bureau of Immigration, Ministry of Home Affairs
processing_time: Submit arrival details within 24 hours after arrival and departure details within 24 hours after departure.
online_process: Register the accommodation provider and submit online Form III on the Bureau of Immigration accommodation-reporting portal. https://indianfrro.gov.in/frro/FormC
offline_process: Foreigners Regional Registration Office, Delhi, FRRO Delhi, East Block-VIII, Level-II, Sector-1, R.K. Puram, New Delhi 110066
required_documents: Accommodation-provider user-registration details; guest passport, visa or OCI particulars; arrival and departure dates; address in India and next destination; and the stay particulars required in online Form III.
eligibility: Every keeper of a hotel, guest house, dharamshala, institute, individual house or other accommodation who provides lodging to a foreign national, including an OCI cardholder.
verification_notes: The 2025 Rules use Form III; the government portal still retains the legacy Form C path name. This is statutory foreign-guest reporting, not routine police verification of Indian hotel guests.

name: Notarized Affidavit
issuing_office: Licensed Notary / Oath Commissioner as accepted by the receiving authority
department: Revenue Department / Department of Legal Affairs
online_process: Obtain the exact recipient-prescribed format and stamp value, purchase the applicable e-stamp or stamp paper, then sign before an authorised notary or oath commissioner with identity and supporting evidence. https://www.shcilestamp.com/
offline_process: Licensed notary / Oath Commissioner, Authorised practitioner in Delhi; filing occurs with the receiving authority
required_documents: Draft affidavit in the exact format required by the receiving authority; declarant identity and address proof; supporting records for the facts sworn; applicable non-judicial e-stamp or stamp paper; and personal signature before the notary or oath commissioner.
eligibility: A declarant who must make a sworn statement for a Delhi government, court, property, education, identity or private legal purpose.
verification_notes: Official Delhi material is not uniform for a generic affidavit. Schedule I displays a ₹1 affidavit duty, while current department forms commonly require ₹10 non-judicial stamp paper. Government Fee and Expected Processing Time are blank because the receiving authority's exact form controls the stamp value and there is no universal affidavit SLA.
